**Finding: IP — compliant (no redline proposed).**

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement contains no deliverables, work-product, IP-licence, or Customer Data provision at all — Suppliers sit outside the Agreement under the separate Supply Contract placed by the Procurement Group (4.4). Ownership is instead handled at the asset level, and it runs in our favour:

- **We own what we pay for:** 12.2 vests Allocated Capacity "on an ownership basis … in return for their financial investment"; 4.1/4.3 allocate Segment and Wet Segment ownership per Schedule B. Outright ownership exceeds the fallback's perpetual/irrevocable/worldwide/royalty-free licence.
- **Unrestricted exploitation (sublicensing analogue):** 12.20 (sell IRU "without any restrictions") and 12.22 (make capacity available "on any commercial basis without any restrictions").
- **Nothing assigned away:** no assignment of our IP or data to the other Parties; Paragraph 31 is mutual confidentiality, not a licence in our data.
- **Joint ownership:** the Wet Segment held "in common and undivided shares" (4.3) is the consortium bargain and is paired with unrestricted exploitation of our capacity, so it does not reach the walk-away.

Noted in the rationale only, not redlined: ownership is term-limited with realisation of assets under Paragraph 18 rather than expressed as perpetual, and third-party disclosure of APCN 2 data needs Management Committee approval (31.1). Neither is a material fallback failure, and inserting vendor-style assignment language into a symmetric multi-party consortium would be inapposite.
